subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : NJR :: OKS : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Given: # : NJR :: OKS : %

So, checking each option one by one:

Option 1) # = LHP, % = QMV → LHP : NJR :: OKS : QMV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e676a964fbe1c391eac9a43b0f4147f0cfaa3ccb8c491add77ee8a19eda774a.png] 

Option 2) # = LHO, % = QMU → LHO : NJR :: OKS : QMU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ecb8ea760a198b7506b5d8c345d33d18cad5ee1516c833062d948464e747eb3.png] 

Option 3) # = LHP, % = QNU → LHP : NJR :: OKS : QNU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3257ac52ef6bddf036370e1fe539104fe4f167ec8ecf0658f7dc55c3ba8bf893.png] 

Option 4) # = LHP, % = QMU → LHP : NJR :: OKS : QMU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c196d53ae3574df3d07e8c2fe7fa0812dc42b39ac7e6ba341c40e2d11a26586d.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
